executive_summary:
Episode 36 combines (a) host's reconstruction of a multi-month timeline linking the Macron investigation to events surrounding the Charlie Kirk assassination, much of which is host narration referencing prior-episode material, with (b) four distinct artifact-anchored evidentiary segments presented in this episode. The artifact-anchored material consists of: (1) a displayed text exchange between host and Charlie Kirk from February 24–25, 2025 documenting White House and POTUS-side contact regarding the Macron topic; (2) a displayed internal legal-team communication from July 27, 2025 analyzing Delaware jurisdictional defects in the Macron lawsuit; (3) an audio/video clip from Brian Harpole's appearance on the Shawn Ryan show in which he read aloud text messages between Dan Flood and UVU Police Chief Jeff Long about student roof access, presented in a manner the host asserts was misrepresentative; and (4) a KUTV investigative report documenting that Washington County Sheriff's office states Tyler Robinson surveillance footage is no longer available, citing a 30-day retention period. A Tucker Carlson speech clip from the July 18 Turning Point event is also played. The episode does not present new primary artifacts supporting the bulk of the host's broader timeline claims about the Satis hanger, the Egyptian plane schedule, the foreign-dignitary transfer, the MK Ultra / Stanford line of investigation, or the phone calls with Andrew Kovette and the unnamed CIA-contractor spouse; these are preserved as host assertions and excluded from the Claim Register per the admission test.

---

sub_items.description: Displayed text exchange between Candace Owens and Charlie Kirk (Feb 24–25, 2025), including Charlie's message "Hey, I have something to tell you from the White House. They asked me to call you. I'm just the messenger here, but it's important," host's reply, follow-up exchange about circling back, and Charlie's Feb 25 text "The White House just asked for your number FYI. I think POTUS might call you."

Displayed private communication between host and her legal team (July 27, 2025), including counsel's assessment that the Macron lawsuit should be dismissed for forum non conveniens, citing host's Tennessee domicile, lack of Delaware defamation, witnesses in Tennessee, and Macron parties not being Delaware citizens.

Audio/video clip from the Shawn Ryan show featuring Brian Harpole (Turning Point USA head of security), including his reading of the Flood–Long text exchange and his characterization of his communication with UVU Police Chief Jeff Long.

Text exchange between Dan Flood (Turning Point USA security) and UVU Police Chief Jeff Long, read aloud by Brian Harpole during the Shawn Ryan interview, covering student roof access at the Sorenson Center (with staircases to walkways/roofs), the request for controlled access or TP personnel presence, and Chief Long's response "I got you covered."

Audio/video clip of KUTV investigative report on missing Washington County Sheriff's office surveillance footage of Tyler Robinson, including Sheriff Nate Brooksby's September 17, 2025 press conference ("Our job was not to interview. Our job was just to get him here" / "Within the hour, my friend drove Tyler and his parents to my office where he was greeted by plain clothes detectives"), records-request responses stating no records responsive and Robinson "did not go to the jail area," and the later response citing the "30-day retention period."

claims.label: White House Contacted Candace Owens via Charlie Kirk About Macron Topic (Feb 24, 2025)
claims.claim: The displayed text exchange documents Charlie Kirk informing Candace Owens that "the White House" asked him to call her, with Kirk characterizing himself as "just the messenger here, but it's important."
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate text message metadata; identify the specific White House staffer or office referenced; cross-reference with White House call logs.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Stated POTUS Might Call Candace Owens Directly (Feb 25, 2025)
claims.claim: The displayed text exchange documents Charlie Kirk informing host that "The White House just asked for your number FYI. I think POTUS might call you."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with the host's separately claimed Feb 26 Trump call; verify call records; confirm POTUS-side initiator.

claims.label: Host's Legal Team Identified No Delaware Jurisdiction Basis in Macron Lawsuit (July 27, 2025)
claims.claim: Displayed legal-team communication asserts the Macron lawsuit should be moved/dismissed for forum non conveniens, citing host's Tennessee domicile, lack of Delaware defamation, Tennessee-based witnesses, and Macron parties not being Delaware citizens.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying court filings and motion-to-dismiss documents; verify jurisdictional analysis against Macron Delaware corporate registrations; check final ruling on motion.

claims.label: Brian Harpole Presented Flood–Long Text Exchange as His Own Communication
claims.claim: Host asserts Brian Harpole described the Dan Flood–Jeff Long text exchange using phrasing consistent with presenting it as his own correspondence, rather than identifying it as a Flood–Long exchange.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare full Shawn Ryan interview transcript with authenticated text-message records; verify who authored and received the communications.

claims.label: Flood–Long Text Exchange Discussed Student Roof Access at Sorenson Center
claims.claim: The text exchange as read in the episode documents an outreach about student roof access (Sorenson Center staircases to walkways/roofs near the CK setup), a request for either controlled access or TP personnel presence, and Chief Long's response "I got you covered."
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate text records via UVU and Turning Point; cross-reference with UVU Police event-day access logs and rooftop control measures.

claims.label: Washington County Sheriff's Office States Tyler Robinson Surveillance Footage No Longer Available
claims.claim: KUTV investigative report documents that Washington County Sheriff's office responded to records requests stating there were no records responsive to requests for surveillance footage of Tyler Robinson at the facility.
claims.investigative_direction: Submit additional GRAMA requests; check for court-issued preservation orders; verify chain-of-custody with other involved agencies.

claims.label: Washington County Cites 30-Day Retention Period for Footage Unavailability
claims.claim: Washington County Sheriff's office response to the generalized records request, as reported by KUTV, stated that "the surveillance footage is no longer available after the 30-day retention period."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Washington County's written retention policy; verify standard practice for high-profile cases; check whether Utah County or any other agency holds preserved copies.

claims.label: Brooksby Statement: Friend Drove Tyler Robinson and Parents to Sheriff's Office
claims.claim: Washington County Sheriff Nate Brooksby, in his September 17, 2025 press conference as reported by KUTV, stated: "Within the hour, my friend drove Tyler and his parents to my office where he was greeted by plain clothes detectives."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Brooksby's account with charging documents, defense filings, witness statements, and any subsequent corrections.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson Criticized Epstein-Connected and Crony Wealth at Turning Point Event (July 18, 2025)
claims.claim: The played audio clip documents Tucker Carlson at a Turning Point event criticizing Epstein-connected wealth (Gulf Streams, island, ranch, NYC residence), naming Bill Ackman, and arguing U.S. wealth is not merit-based.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full speech transcript and video; verify exact date, venue, and audience; cross-reference with TPUSA's own published event materials.
